paper_claims.claim: the three committed corpora carry 72, 5,184 and 600 histories
the two stabilizer routes disagree at 0 objects
identity is forced on 5,852 histories and chart on 4
the crystallization time is exactly 5 on C1, C2 and the seed fan
4 histories never crystallize, and they are the constant-class quadruples ANT|ANT|ANT|ANT, COL|COL|COL|COL, DIA|DIA|DIA|DIA, ROW|ROW|ROW|ROW
the co-division relation is preserved by every one of the 121,152 stabilizer elements, at 0 violations
the weld dictionary's readings agree under precomposition at 121,152 comparisons with 0 differences
the record's attribution is orbit-constant at 111 of 703 objects and naming-dependent at 592
the Born menu is orbit-constant at 134,58,58,58,58 objects by depth
813 of the 121,152 stabilizer elements are symmetries of the coupled step, exactly the translations
at 24 of the 600 R = 4 histories the co-division relation is the constant complete graph while the stabilizer is trivial
the record's blind fraction is 3/19 by distinct prefix and 1235/6008 by corpus multiplicity
the groupoid grain is registered and not run

rows: THE 72 R = 3 I7-STRICT TRIPLES, ENTIRE.  Every ordered triple of saturating groupings whose summed link field covers all 27 cells; driven at the FIRST canonical transversal of each round.  No sampling: the corpus is the whole class.

THE SEED FAN OVER W-C1, ENTIRE.  The same 72 triples at ALL 27 canonical transversal triples, so the seed axis -- the only coordinate that moves the WITHIN-ROUND event order -- is exhausted rather than fixed.
THE 5,184 ORDERED R = 6 CONCATENATIONS, ENTIRE.  Every ordered pair of W-C1 triples, concatenated -- paper-21's own R = 6 door, at its own ordered-witness count.

PAPER-21's DRIVEN WINDOW W4, ENTIRE.  All 600 committed schedules -- W4-CLASS, W4-FLAT, W4-SEEDFAN and W4-CTRL -- reconstructed here by paper-21's own constructor and gated against its committed window size.

THE DRIVEN VERIFICATION SET.  The committed v10 layers are expensive to drive, so the driven leg is taken on a DECLARED set: the first 9 W-C1 triples in enumeration order, the four constant-class W-C3 quadruples together with d66's own committed R = 4 point and the collinear arrangement, and the first 2 W-C2 concatenations.  Each is compared event by event against the combinatorial route, and the structural leg carries the rest.
THE AUTOMORPHISM WINDOW OVER W-C2.  The co-division automorphism group is enumerated on the 72 DIAGONAL concatenations (T, T) -- paper-21's own R = 6 witness form -- rather than on all 5,184.
THE WALK'S DEPTH.  Paper-20's coupled step is re-implemented here and run to depth 5 from the S_9-symmetric start; every depth is published, so the depth is not a hidden cap.

probes: identity is forced on all but four committed histories
the walk refines the record from depth two
the groupoid grain is registered and not run

sources.why: THIS UNIT'S PIN (ledger #268, commit f1e9fbf): the formal object, the three corpora, the five stages, the outcome names and the grain note.
PAPER 19 (terminal, commit 559e162): the R = 3 arena, the weld dictionary -- site from ACTOR, link from the CO-DIVISION ACTOR PAIR, count from the division count -- and the 72 I7-STRICT triples.
PAPER 19's COMMITTED RECEIPT (commit 559e162): the R = 3 arena as data -- divisions per record, the isomorphism count, the strict-triple count -- read from these bytes and reproduced here.
PAPER 19's COMMITTED DRIVER (commit 559e162): the schedule driver this unit re-implements, and the `record_of` footprint rule it inherits.
PAPER 21 (terminal, commit 7d675c1): the R = 4 window of 600 driven schedules, the R = 6 door -- 72 triples, 5,184 ordered concatenations -- and the driven-equals-combinatorial licence.

waiver_ledger.forcing: the run cannot proceed past a source whose bytes do not match the frozen digest, so the gate has no other value to take
waiver_ledger.waiver: MACHINE-CHECKED FORCING: this gate's falsifier is the CLI's own `--selftest`, which corrupts one declared anchor's digest and requires the run to die here and write nothing.  It is an executable falsifier rather than a registry mutant because it must run before the mutant harness itself is trusted.

waiver_ledger.forcing: the run cannot proceed past a source whose bytes do not match the frozen digest, so the gate has no other value to take
waiver_ledger.waiver: MACHINE-CHECKED FORCING: a mutant of this gate would have to WRITE artifacts, which the era forbids of a failing run, so the falsifier is carried INSIDE the gate instead -- the same disk-vs-seal comparison is run a second time on the same disk bytes with one bit flipped and is required to REJECT.  The gate therefore fires in both directions in every plain run.

walk.born_weight_form: |a + b w|^2 = a^2 - a b + b^2, a rational integer
walk.coin: C(x) = G . D(x), D(x) = diag(w^{n_l(x)}); 3G has -1 on the diagonal and 2 off it
walk.symmetry_criterion: a stabilizer element is a symmetry of the coupled step exactly when it is a translation of AG(2,3) and preserves the record

windows.declaration: THE 72 R = 3 I7-STRICT TRIPLES, ENTIRE.  Every ordered triple of saturating groupings whose summed link field covers all 27 cells; driven at the FIRST canonical transversal of each round.  No sampling: the corpus is the whole class.
windows.name: W-C1

windows.declaration: THE SEED FAN OVER W-C1, ENTIRE.  The same 72 triples at ALL 27 canonical transversal triples, so the seed axis -- the only coordinate that moves the WITHIN-ROUND event order -- is exhausted rather than fixed.
windows.name: W-C1FAN

windows.declaration: THE 5,184 ORDERED R = 6 CONCATENATIONS, ENTIRE.  Every ordered pair of W-C1 triples, concatenated -- paper-21's own R = 6 door, at its own ordered-witness count.
windows.name: W-C2

windows.declaration: PAPER-21's DRIVEN WINDOW W4, ENTIRE.  All 600 committed schedules -- W4-CLASS, W4-FLAT, W4-SEEDFAN and W4-CTRL -- reconstructed here by paper-21's own constructor and gated against its committed window size.
windows.name: W-C3

windows.declaration: THE DRIVEN VERIFICATION SET.  The committed v10 layers are expensive to drive, so the driven leg is taken on a DECLARED set: the first 9 W-C1 triples in enumeration order, the four constant-class W-C3 quadruples together with d66's own committed R = 4 point and the collinear arrangement, and the first 2 W-C2 concatenations.  Each is compared event by event against the combinatorial route, and the structural leg carries the rest.
windows.name: W-DRIVE

windows.declaration: THE AUTOMORPHISM WINDOW OVER W-C2.  The co-division automorphism group is enumerated on the 72 DIAGONAL concatenations (T, T) -- paper-21's own R = 6 witness form -- rather than on all 5,184.
windows.name: W-AUTC2

windows.declaration: THE WALK'S DEPTH.  Paper-20's coupled step is re-implemented here and run to depth 5 from the S_9-symmetric start; every depth is published, so the depth is not a hidden cap.
windows.name: W-WALK
